**Google launches one work agent that routes jobs to Gemini or Claude models.** The Gemini agent can research, create documents, write code and complete tasks lasting hours or days, with its own Gmail, Calendar and Drive storage. It is in private preview for a select group of customers, with no date for wider availability. [VentureBeat, 8 Oct 2026](https://venturebeat.com/ai/google-cloud-unveils-persistent-gemini-agents-for-long-running-tasks-and-they-get-their-own-gmail-calendar-and-drive-storage)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-09-gemini-4-argon-release" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-09/gemini-4-argon-release/" data-aixpm-date="2026-09-30" data-aixpm-title="Google&#x27;s Gemini 4 Argon arrives, at first only for vetted cyber defenders." markdown>

**Google's Gemini 4 Argon arrives, at first only for vetted cyber defenders.** Google describes Argon as built for long-horizon professional tasks, with a 1-million-token limit, and strong at coding, financial research and legal drafting. It is rolling out to trusted cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program before wider release. [Google, 30 Sep 2026](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-4-argon/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-08-gemini-3-7-flash-release" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-08/gemini-3-7-flash-release/" data-aixpm-date="2026-08-31" data-aixpm-title="Google released Gemini 3.7 Flash at half its predecessor&#x27;s launch price." markdown>

**Google released Gemini 3.7 Flash at half its predecessor's launch price.** Arriving three weeks after 3.6 Flash, it costs $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens until the end of 2026. Google reports gains on complex document processing (34.0% vs 22.0% on GDP.pdf) and business-workflow automation (30.4% vs 17.0% on AutomationBench); these are its own benchmarks. [9to5Google, 13 Aug 2026](https://9to5google.com/2026/08/13/gemini-3-7-flash-launch/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-07-gemini-3-6-flash-release" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-07/gemini-3-6-flash-release/" data-aixpm-date="2026-07-31" data-aixpm-title="Google released Gemini 3.6 Flash, cheaper than 3.5 Flash and aimed at agents run at scale." markdown>

**Google released Gemini 3.6 Flash, cheaper than 3.5 Flash and aimed at agents run at scale.** Priced at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, it uses 17% fewer output tokens than 3.5 Flash on the Artificial Analysis Index, according to Google, and makes computer use a built-in tool in the Gemini API and Gemini Enterprise. It shipped with 3.5 Flash-Lite and a security-focused 3.5 Flash Cyber; the performance figures are those cited by Google. [Google, 21 Jul 2026](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-3-6-flash-3-5-flash-lite-3-5-flash-cyber/)
